title: Initial Revelation of Demonic Path Secrets
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing said meaningfully: 'Chen Ji, your Tianji Record... might itself be a shackle.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's voice fell, the arc at the corner of Ye Qing's lips deepened even further. In the dim chamber, her slender fingers tapped lightly on the stone table, the rhythm like a heartbeat—one beat, then another. 'Seven days?' She raised her gaze to Chen Ji, her eyes flickering with a scrutinizing light. 'I thought you would make a bold demand, asking for results in three days.' Amid the flickering lamplight, her profile was half lit and half shadowed, growing ever more mysterious and unpredictable.

dialogue.content: Within seven days, I want to know all the intelligence on the Demonic Path Commander.

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained calm, as if he were merely discussing today's weather. Yet in the depths of those seemingly turbid eyes, a flash of sharp light vanished in an instant. 'Three days is too urgent, easily alerting the target.' He lifted the teacup before him, gently blowing away the curling wisps of steam. 'Seven days is just enough—for you to lay your plans and for me to verify.' Upon hearing this, Ye Qing let out a light laugh, but the笑意 did not reach her eyes—this was precisely the answer she wanted, a truly opponent who understood the game.

dialogue.content: Fine, seven days it is. But before we discuss the deal, I'm curious—why do you care so much about the Demonic Path Commander?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He set down the teacup, his gaze passing over Ye Qing to fall upon the pitch-black night sky beyond the window. The three major sects contending, the Demonic Path invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land—on this chessboard of chaos, every piece was seeking its own position. And he needed to know the details of the one who moved the pieces. The night wind outside the chamber suddenly turned biting, causing the window lattice to creak, as if something was drawing near.

dialogue.content: Because I need to know who my enemy truly is. Know yourself and your enemy, and you shall win a hundred battles.

text.content: Ye Qing's gaze flickered subtly. Chen Ji's answer was airtight, yet it made her increasingly certain—this man was far from simple. She rose slowly, the deep crimson-purple hem of her skirt trailing elegant arcs across the stone floor as she walked toward a bronze mirror in the depths of the chamber. 'Since that is the case, I shall give you a meeting gift.' She swept her hand across the mirror's surface, and a blurry image gradually emerged within it. 'Regarding the Demonic Path Commander... I only know three things.'

dialogue.content: First, his true identity is the highest secret of the entire Demonic Path—even a Saint like myself has no authority to know it. Second... the martial art he cultivates seems to have a strange resonance with some kind of ancient prophetic technique.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Ancient prophetic technique—the Tianji Record fragment in his chest faintly pulsed with heat, as if responding to something. He forcefully suppressed the turmoil in his heart, his expression unchanged as always. But Ye Qing was extremely perceptive; she caught Chen Ji's momentary异样, and the smile at the corner of her lips deepened. The image in the bronze mirror began to distort, and a figure in black robes could be vaguely seen, surrounded by arcane patterns remarkably similar to Chen Ji's Tianji Record.

Chen Ji's voice remained calm, but Ye Qing distinctly heard the suppressed urgency within it. She did not answer directly; instead, she countered with a question: 'Do you know who the creator of the Tianji Record originally was?' This question struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. Mo Xiansheng—the mysterious guardian existing as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record—had never directly answered this question.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing posed a key piece of information—the creator of the Tianji Record. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Directly inquire about the secrets of the Tianji Record's creator, trading sincerity for more intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Expose Dependency on the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing Might Use This to Coerce

dialogue.content: The creator of the Tianji Record... What do you know?

choices.description: Maintain mystery, do not expose the desire for information about the Tianji Record, hinting at other intelligence sources.

dialogue.content: I have my own sources of information. You only need to tell me the connection between the Demonic Path Commander and the Tianji Record.

choices.description: Take a step back to advance, proactively reveal partial information about the Tianji Record in exchange for equal trust and intelligence.

dialogue.content: Since you mentioned the creator of the Tianji Record... I might as well be frank. The Tianji Record is indeed in my possession. But what I hold is merely fragments.

text.content: Ye Qing did not wait for Chen Ji's answer; she continued on her own: 'According to the most ancient records of the Holy Sect, the creator of the Tianji Record was not of the human race.' Her voice was low and mysterious, each word like an ancient bell toll. 'That was a... being that descended from the Heavenly Realm. It scattered the Tianji Record into countless fragments, scattered across the world, waiting for worthy souls to collect.' The image in the bronze mirror grew increasingly clear—the patterns around that black-robed figure bore a startling resemblance to the mark on Chen Ji's chest.

dialogue.content: And the third thing, the most crucial—near the Demonic Path Commander, there is a person who once saw the complete Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji's breath nearly stopped at this moment. The complete Tianji Record—that was something he had never dared to hope for. Mo Xiansheng had said that the complete Tianji Record contained the power to rewrite Heavenly Fate, yet it also carried a backlash sufficient to devour its user. And now, Ye Qing told him that the complete Tianji Record not only existed but had been witnessed by someone. His mind raced rapidly, countless thoughts colliding—was this person? Why would they be beside the Demonic Path Commander?

Just then, a low rumbling vibration came from the depths of the chamber. Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly; she tilted her head to listen, her brow gradually furrowing. 'There is a disturbance deep within the secret realm...' she murmured to herself, a hint of unease in her voice, 'As if an ancient ruin is about to open.' Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record fragment in his embrace grow slightly warm; that familiar sensation told him—Ye Qing spoke true. Something long dormant was awakening.

choice.prompt: An ancient ruin is about to open, and strange movements come from the depths of the secret realm. How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden change?

choices.description: Take advantage of the chaos to enter the secret realm and explore the ancient ruin, seizing the opportunity before the Demonic Path Commander.
choices.visible_reward: Might Obtain Tianji Record Fragments or Ancient Inheritance
choices.risk_hint: There Must Be Danger in the Ruins

text.content: The ancient ruins... perhaps hold the answers I need. Ye Qing, can you take me into the secret realm?

choices.description: Remain motionless, wait for various forces to enter first and exhaust each other's strength, then seize the opportunity.
choices.risk_hint: The Ruins Might Be Seized by Others

text.content: No need to rush. Let the Demonic Path and the three major sects scout first. When they have exhausted each other... we net the catch.

choices.description: First exchange intelligence about the ruins with Ye Qing, confirm whether they are related to the Tianji Record before deciding.
choices.visible_cost: Might Expose the Secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain More Truth About the Ruins
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing Might Have Other Designs

dialogue.content: Are these ruins... connected to the Tianji Record?

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji for a moment, seemingly weighing something. Finally, she spoke softly: 'This ruin... within the Holy Sect, we call it the 'Tianji Tomb.' Legend has it that it is the place where the creator of the Tianji Record fell.' Chen Ji's heart lurched—the place where the creator of the Tianji Record fell. What did this mean? Remnants of the complete Tianji Record? Or something even more astonishing? He unconsciously pressed his hand to his chest, feeling the warmth emanating from that page of fragments, as if responding to some ancient and profound call.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Tomb... Legend says the creator of the Tianji Record did not die at the hands of external enemies, but was instead counteracted by its own prophecy. Before falling, it sealed its lifetime of insights into a secret realm, to be claimed by worthy successors in later generations. And in recent years, the Demonic Path Commander's constant invasions of this area were probably for...

text.content: Before her words could finish, the chamber shook violently once more. This time, it was even more intense. The bronze lamp hanging on the wall swayed violently, stretching and compressing their shadows like shadows playing across the wall. Ye Qing's expression shifted; she strode quickly to the corner, pressing a protruding hidden compartment. An ancient jade slip弹出 from the compartment; she grabbed it, her spiritual sense probing within, and her face changed dramatically moments later. 'Bad—the seal on the Tianji Tomb is loosening. In seven days at most, the entire secret realm will collapse!'

Seven days. A flash of sharp light gleamed in Chen Ji's eyes. This number coincided perfectly with the deadline he had proposed to Ye Qing. He raised his head to look at Ye Qing; their eyes met, and without a word, they had reached a kind of tacit understanding. The secret realm was about to collapse, which meant all forces would rush to action. The Demonic Path Commander, Xuanwu Sect, even the undercurrents within the Tianqing Sect... everyone would surge into this area within seven days. And he, Chen Ji, had to find his own opportunity within—whether regarding the truth of the Tianji Record, or that mysterious 'person who saw the complete Tianji Record.'

Ye Qing put away the jade slip, turning to face Chen Ji. Her expression became unprecedentedly serious; the playfulness and probing from earlier had completely vanished, replaced by an almost solemn gravity. 'Chen Ji, what I am about to say next, you must listen carefully.' She approached slowly, lowering her voice. 'Near the Demonic Path Commander, there exists a being called the 'Fragment Guardian.' No one knows his true identity, but every time he appears, it triggers a resonance in the Tianji Record.' She paused, her gaze sharp as a blade. 'And according to the records of the Holy Sect... this Fragment Guardian has a bloodline connection to the creator of the Tianji Record.'

Chen Ji fell silent. A bloodline connection—this meant the person beside the Demonic Path Commander might be a descendant of the Tianji Record's creator, or perhaps even... a created being. The Tianji Record fragment in his chest quivered slightly, as if responding to some distant call. Mo Xiansheng's figure surfaced in Chen Ji's mind—that always vague and mysterious guardian. Did he know all this too? Or was he himself part of this puzzle? The fog in Chen Ji's heart grew thicker, but simultaneously, a grander chess game was taking shape in his mind.

dialogue.content: There is one more thing. Every time the Fragment Guardian appears, he says one phrase—'Heavenly Secrets return to their place, the shackles shall open.' The elders of the Holy Sect studied it for a long time, but none understood what it meant. However, I once saw similar records in an incomplete ancient text...

text.content: Ye Qing's voice suddenly dropped, almost murmuring: 'It is said that the Tianji Record is not merely a prophetic technique. Its true purpose is to seal something... that should not exist in this world.' She raised her gaze to Chen Ji, her eyes shimmering with complex light. 'And those who collect the fragments of the Tianji Record—are they inheritors, or rather... chosen keys.' The lamps in the chamber flickered violently at this moment, as if some invisible force was eavesdropping on their conversation. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record fragment in his chest suddenly burn with heat, that searing sensation almost scorching him.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing revealed an astonishing truth—the Tianji Record is a sealing artifact, and collectors are chosen keys. How should Chen Ji react?

choices.description: Confess to Ye Qing that he has collected multiple pages of Tianji Record fragments, testing whether she knows more inside information.
choices.visible_reward: Might Obtain Key Information or Ye Qing's Full Support
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing Might Covet the Tianji Record

text.content: Since we have come this far, I will not hide it from you. The Tianji Record fragments I possess number more than one.

choices.description: Hide the shock in the depths of one's heart, silently extract more information without letting Ye Qing察觉 one's reaction.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the Opportunity for In-Depth Exchange
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing Might Have Already Become Suspicious

text.content: Keys... interesting. Then what is the sealed thing?

choices.description: Do not follow Ye Qing's topic; instead, question why she knows so much about the secrets of the Tianji Record, probing her true purpose.

dialogue.content: You seem to know far more than I imagined. As a Saint of the Demonic Path, why are you so well-versed about the Tianji Record?

text.content: Ye Qing was momentarily stunned by Chen Ji's sudden counter-question. She carefully examined this seemingly timid servant disciple before her, her gaze growing ever more complicated. After a moment, she actually laughed lightly; that laughter echoed in the silent chamber, carrying a hint of self-mockery, a touch of relief. 'You truly are no simple matter.' She did not answer directly; instead, she slowly raised her right hand, her sleeve sliding down to reveal a pale wrist as white as snow—upon that wrist, a诡异的 black pattern wound upward, like some kind of brand.

dialogue.content: You ask a good question. This mark was branded by the Holy Sect when I was twelve years old. It monitors my every move at all times, devouring my lifespan. So you see, I want to know the answer even more than you—when the hell can this damned mark be removed.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at that black pattern, his mind racing rapidly. Ye Qing's words were half true and half false, but one thing was certain—her days at the Holy Sect were not easy. That place that took her sister Chen Nian as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' that behemoth controlling the entire Demonic Path... A cold glint flickered in the depths of Chen Ji's eyes, but his expression remained unmoved. 'So we cooperate, each taking what we need.' he said. 'In seven days, we shall see the outcome at the secret realm.' Upon hearing this, Ye Qing finally displayed a genuine smile. 'A promise is a promise.'

The vibrations outside the chamber gradually subsided, but Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. Tianji Tomb, Demonic Path Commander, Fragment Guardian... these clues, like scattered puzzle pieces, were gradually forming a vague yet astonishing picture in his mind. The creator of the Tianji Record, the sealed thing, the chosen keys—these words intertwined, sketching out a truth he had never imagined. And that ever-vague Mo Xiansheng, his position in Chen Ji's heart had grown increasingly heavy. Did he know all this? Was he friend or foe?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, your Tianji Record... might itself be a shackle.
